title: Fixed Split Open Frames And Blunt Point Crampon
description: One newly authored complete fixed empty open-frame crampon appearance. Separate full forefoot and heel frames have genuine large through openings and a narrow bridging strip; eight tapered downward teeth with finite blunt sole patches and two front-projecting blunt teeth are independent complete solids rooted within the frames. A complete bent front bail spans the open front foot space; a rear bent heel bail and a fixed upright heel lever sit on the heel frame. No boot, person, pair duplicate or snowshoe web. Unlike the broad raised-nose laced snowshoe, this small split metal frame is open under the foot and ends in ground-point teeth rather than an area-support web. Unlike hollow boots, there is no enclosed upper, toe pocket, shaft, cuff or outsole. Every geometric coordinate is newly authored; no existing mesh extracted. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metre units Z up. Connections are fixed visual overlaps, not articulated joints or working binding tolerances. No wearable fit, boot compatibility, traction, climbing, ice penetration, attachment or release function, load, manufacture, protective equipment, operation or safety claim. Static decorative game art only; no rigging, animation or interaction.
